info.name: Spot AI — Spot Connect (beta) Analytics Embeds API
Generate an embeddable URL for a live camera feed

items.docs:
Generates an embeddable URL for a live camera feed that can be used in an iframe.

This endpoint requires the `camera_share_create` permission on the specified camera.

info.name: Generate an embeddable URL for a VOD camera feed

items.docs:
Generates an embeddable URL for a VOD (Video on Demand) camera feed
that can be used in an iframe.

This endpoint requires the `clip_share_create` permission on the specified camera.
